senses.gloss:
ITA-7.2.5.5 lauham/lohaḥ लौहम्/लोहः
Iron
Fe (Ferrum). Duly processed loha is employed as a standalone medicine or as an ingredient in the preparation of polyherbo-mineral pharmaceutical formulations.

ITA-5.76.205 lohitakā लोहितका
Condition of neck stiffness due to improper piercing of child’s ear
A condition characterized by neck and head stiffness; tetanus; and earache.

ITA-5.41.21 lohitamehaḥ/ raktamehaḥ लोहितमेहः/रक्तमेहः
Polyuria disorder with urine mixed with blood
A disorder characterized by urine smelling like raw flesh; urine tasting like saline; reddish urine; elimination of urine which is hot in nature; passage of blood with urine.

ITA-3.16.39 lohitākṣaḥ (marma) लोहिताक्षः (मर्म)
Vulnerable location(s) near the upper part of the thigh below inguinal region
Two in number (one in each lower limb) which when injured causes severe bleeding leading to paralysis or death.

ITA-5.66.49 lohitārma/ kṣatārma लोहितार्म/क्षतार्म
Progressive pterygium
A disorder characterized by muscular growth resembling a lotus; even muscular growth; glossy muscular growth; soft tissue resembling a lotus flower.

ITA-5.66.75 śuṣkārśaḥ/ lohitārśaḥ शुष्कार्शः/लोहितार्शः
Granuloma or polyp-like growth
A disorder characterized by long; rough; firm and troublesome bud-like projections; rough; stiffness of eyelids; occurring on inner side of eyelids

ITA-3.14.10 Lohitikā लोहितिका
Vein located in the ear
